from mathutils import Vector

# -------- Utility: clean scene --------
for c in list(bpy.data.collections):

# -------- Render/world setup --------

scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'

    nt = mat.node_tree

        nt.nodes.remove(n)
    out = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')

        bsdf = nt.nodes.new('ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
        bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = base_color
        bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
        bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic

# Middle cone

    tree_coll.objects.link(part)

# Fireplace block near corner along right wall

bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = fireplace
bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=mod.name)
bpy.data.objects.remove(cut, do_unlink=True)

# Emissive plane as fire
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1.0, location=(-0.8, 2.45, 0.45))
fire_plane = bpy.context.active_object
fire_plane.rotation_euler = (math.radians(90), 0, 0)  # face -Y
fire_plane.scale = (0.45, 0.3, 1)
fire_plane.data.materials.append(make_mat('FireEmission', emission=(1.2, 0.5, 0.1, 1), emission_strength=8.0))

# Sofa (seat + back)
# Seat
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=2, location=(1.9, 1.2, 0.225))
sofa_seat = bpy.context.active_object
sofa_seat.scale = (1.1, 0.5, 0.225)  # 2.2 x 1.0 x 0.45

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=2, location=(1.9, 1.8, 0.75))
sofa_back = bpy.context.active_object
sofa_back.scale = (1.1, 0.1, 0.3)
sofa_mat = make_mat('SofaBeige', base_color=(0.95, 0.80, 0.55, 1), rough=0.7)
sofa_seat.data.materials.append(sofa_mat)
sofa_back.data.materials.append(sofa_mat)

# Coffee table (simple top + 4 legs)

table_top = bpy.context.active_object
table_top.scale = (0.5, 0.3, 0.03)  # 1.0 x 0.6 x 0.06
wood_mat = make_mat('TableWood', base_color=(0.35, 0.18, 0.08, 1), rough=0.8)

leg_offsets = [(0.42, 0.22), (-0.42, 0.22), (0.42, -0.22), (-0.42, -0.22)]

    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=2, location=(0.3 + ox, 0.8 + oy, 0.12))
    leg = bpy.context.active_object
    leg.scale = (0.04, 0.04, 0.12)
    leg.data.materials.append(wood_mat)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=1.0, depth=0.02, location=(0.3, 0.8, 0.01))
rug = bpy.context.active_object
rug_mat = make_mat('RugRed', base_color=(0.8, 0.2, 0.15, 1), rough=0.9)

fire_light.energy = 150

fire_light_obj.location = (-0.8, 2.5, 0.6)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(fire_light_obj)

print('Coarse scene constructed.')
